Good to know

Before your
first session.

Is Fikr Vox free?

The app’s source code is free to use under the MIT license. Local models run on your Mac after setup and download. Connected cloud providers charge separately for their services.

Which Macs are supported?

The current app targets macOS on Apple silicon. Building from source requires Node.js 22 or newer, Rust, and Xcode command-line tools. See the installation guide.

Does everything run locally?

Your desktop projects and imported media are stored locally. Local voice engines run on your Mac. If you choose a cloud provider, the relevant content is sent to that provider when you invoke a generation, writing, or transcription action.

Can I use my own voice?

Yes. Add a voice reference to a twin and select a cloning-capable engine. Preset voices are also available. Use references you have permission to use, and check the model or provider’s terms.

Does video dubbing change lip movements?

No. Dubbing replaces the video’s original audio while preserving the footage. You can set the narration’s start time and choose natural pace or fit-to-video timing.

Where can I download the app?

A packaged release has not been published yet. You can download the source and build Fikr Vox now. Packaged downloads will be listed on the GitHub Releases page when available.
